changes: At most three SYNTIZ tracks in a Part: choosing SYNTIZ for a fourth track is refused, so the unit never crackles from too many SYNTIZ notes at once.
A Part saved with more SYNTIZ tracks still plays as it was.
New track machine SYNTIZ, with six models in a list opened by a double tap of the track key: SAW, PULSE, ENS, TABLE, MORPH and CHOIR.
SAW, PULSE and ENS: stacked, detuned and chorused oscillators; TABLE, MORPH and CHOIR: 32 single-cycle tables with crossfades, sync, bit crush and chords.
Every model has DRIV into a smooth saturator and RTRG; most add a square sub an octave down and a sine two octaves down.
PTCH plays like FLEX's (chromatic keys, scales, locks); OCT on SRC SETUP picks the register.
Experimental: tried on one MKII; it needs a base that knows SYNTIZ.
